title: Assistant Human Resource Manager
description:
Assist the HR Manager in managing day-to-day HR operations.
 Handle end-to-end recruitment, interview coordination, selection, and onboarding.
 Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, and HR documentation.
 Manage monthly payroll processing , including salary calculation, attendance inputs, deductions, incentives, overtime, and final settlements.
 Verify payroll data and ensure timely and accurate salary processing.
 Coordinate with Finance/Accounts for payroll disbursement and resolve salary-related queries.
 Manage statutory payroll compliance, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, and other applicable deductions/returns .
 Prepare and maintain payroll reports, salary registers, and HR MIS.
 Handle employee grievances related to salary, attendance, leave, and other HR matters.
 Coordinate performance appraisals, employee evaluations, and salary revisions.
 Support employee training, development, and engagement activities.
 Ensure compliance with company HR policies and applicable labor laws.
 Conduct joining and exit formalities, including full-and-final settlement.
 Prepare HR and payroll reports for management review.
 Coordinate with different departments regarding manpower requirements and employee-related matters.
 Assist in developing and implementing HR policies, procedures, and processes.

Key Skills: HR Ops,Payroll Management,Compliance Monitoring,Payroll Preparation,HR Operations,Advanced Excel,HR Budgeting,HR Reporting
